resources.string: Connect Jellyfin, Emby, Silo or Plex to browse and play your own library.
Full shows the file name and more detail on server sources. Clean shows only picture, sound and size.
Show the Jellyfin, Emby, Silo or Plex logo next to server sources and in the player.
Sync media servers to my Nuvio account
Off: your servers and their sign-ins stay on this device. On: the server list, including the sign-ins, is saved to your Nuvio account and shared with your other devices.
Remove my servers from my Nuvio account

Turns account sync off and deletes the server list saved in your Nuvio account. The servers on this device stay. Other devices with sync on lose these servers at their next sync. Silo servers are never saved to the account.
Remove your servers from your Nuvio account?
Your servers were removed from your Nuvio account.
Could not reach your Nuvio account. Sign in to it and try again.
Sign in with your server address and %1$s user.
Enter your server address and the %1$s user to sign in with. Your password is only used to sign in.
On a device that is already signed in to %1$s, open Jellyfin, choose your user icon, then Quick Connect, and enter this code.
Quick Connect is switched off on this server. Sign in with your username and password, or ask the server\'s owner to switch it on (Dashboard, General, Quick Connect).
Selected libraries appear in home rows, search, and stream results.
Ticked libraries get a row on Home. Search and stream results always use all libraries.
No movie or series libraries are available to this user.
The name Nuvio Arc shows for this server on Home, in Settings and on sources.
Choose the name Nuvio Arc shows for this server. Leave it empty to use the server\'s own name.
Show this server in Home, search, and stream results.

Titles open with your addons\' details and sync like any other catalog title, with playback and watched marks still sent to %1$s. Some titles may not match or play if your addons number or identify them differently. Turn this off to play from %1$s only, with no addon search.
Titles you have started on %1$s appear in Continue Watching on Home. Watched marks are kept in step either way.
Add titles you\'re watching in %1$s to Continue watching, along with its watched marks. Playback resumes from %1$s either way.
Tried when the first address cannot be reached, for example a home address first and an internet address second.
That address belongs to a different server.
That is already the first address.
Could not reach a server at that address.
This signs you out of %1$s on this device. You can add it back anytime.
This user does not have access.
Could not connect to the server.
This address opens a website, not a media server. Enter the server\'s own address.
Nuvio Arc couldn\'t find this Silo server\'s Jellyfin address. In Silo, open Settings > Connect Apps > Jellyfin-compatible app and enter the address shown under Server.
Jellyfin apps are turned off on this Silo server. Ask the server owner to turn them on.
Add # and your Silo profile name to the end of the username, like name#Profile or name#1234#Profile.
Silo reads the part after the last # as a profile name and has no profile called that. If your username has a # in it, add # and your profile name at the end, like name#1234#Profile.
This Silo profile has a PIN. Add # and the PIN to your password, like password#1234.
Add # and your Silo profile name to the username, and # and that profile\'s PIN to your password.
Too many sign-in attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
The profile PIN after the # in your password is wrong.
Your Silo password is temporary. Sign in on Silo\'s website once to choose a new one.
Password sign-in is turned off on this server. Ask the server owner for an account with a password.
The address you open Silo with works here. Your username and profile are in Silo under Settings > Connect Apps > Jellyfin-compatible app.
Sign in to this server again in Settings.
This item is no longer available on the server.
This server\'s certificate is not recognised.
This server\'s certificate is not recognised
Nuvio Arc could not confirm the identity of %1$s.
The certificate is self-signed or issued by a private authority.
The certificate was issued for a different name.
The certificate is outside its valid dates.

If this is your own server and you expect this, you can trust this certificate. Nuvio Arc will then accept only this exact certificate for this server and will warn you if it ever changes. If you are not on your home network, check the fingerprint with the server\'s owner first.
The secure connection failed and the server\'s certificate could not be read.
The server doesn\'t support this item.
The server allows no more streams for this account right now.
Still checking this server\'s library. Try again in a moment.
Could not start playback from the server.
Could not update watched state on the server.
Titles from your media server can\'t be added to this library. Turn on Use addon metadata for the server to save them here.
Choose which libraries to show in Settings, under Content & Discovery, then Media servers.
Sign in with a code, your Silo password, or Silo\'s Jellyfin address.
The address you open Silo with works here.

Sign in with a code on your phone, or with your Silo password. Works with every way your server signs people in (password, OpenID Connect, LDAP, Tailscale). Brings your Silo profiles and your Silo Home rows.
Uses Silo\'s address for Jellyfin apps, with a username and password (name#Profile for a profile). The way Nuvio Arc connected to Silo so far.
On your phone, scan the code or open %1$s
Sign in there the way you normally do
Check the number matches, then approve
Waiting for approval · code valid for %1$s
Opened on your phone. Finish signing in there.
The sign-in was turned down or withdrawn. Get a new code to try again.
This server doesn\'t offer sign-in with a code.
Couldn\'t get a code from the server.
QR code to sign in to Silo
Your server knows this TV through Tailscale.
Or sign in with a code: %1$s at %2$s
%1$s has more than one profile. Nuvio Arc uses the one you pick for progress, watched marks and Home rows. You can change it later on the server\'s page.
This address doesn\'t answer as Silo. Use the address you open Silo with in a browser, or choose Jellyfin-compatible for Silo\'s Jellyfin address.
Progress, watched marks and Home rows follow this profile.
Show the rows from your Silo Home (your lists, Trending, Next up…) on Nuvio Arc\'s Home.
Signs in with Silo\'s own sign-in, then replaces this connection. Its name and library choices stay.
Sign in with a code at plex.tv/link. Your servers are found for you.
No server address needed: Nuvio Arc finds your Plex servers after you sign in.
On your phone or computer, open %1$s (or scan the code)
Sign in to Plex if asked
Type the code above and press Link
Waiting for you to link · a fresh code appears by itself when this one runs out
The code ran out. Get a new code to try again.
Couldn\'t get a code from Plex.
QR code to sign in to Plex
Signed in as %1$s. These servers are on your Plex account.
There\'s no Plex Media Server on this Plex account.
You can add another Plex server later the same way.
only reachable through Plex Relay (slow, about 2 Mbit/s)
Your Plex account has Plex Home users. Nuvio Arc uses the one you pick for progress, watched marks and Continue Watching on %1$s. You can change it later on the server\'s page.
Progress, watched marks and Continue Watching follow this user.
Show Plex\'s own rows from this server (Recently Added and more) on Nuvio Arc\'s Home.
Plex won\'t play this away from home. In apps like Nuvio Arc that needs Plex Pass on the server, or a Remote Watch Pass for you. At home it plays free.
Many folders (%1$d) make a long row on Home.
